•
 
Should have experience in tax topics like direct or indirect tax
 
 
•
 
Create and implement SAP Finance solutions to meet the organization’s financial needs. 
 
 
•
 
Configure and personalize SAP Finance modules, including Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Accounts 
Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Fixed Asset Accounting (FA) (AA). 
 
 
•
 
Provide end
-
users with functional and technical support, including SAP Finance system training and guidance. 
 
 
•
 
Collaborate with other IT teams and business stakeholders to identify and translate business requirements into SAP 
Finance solutions. 
 
 
•
 
Work with the finance team to ensure the organization’s reporting and analysis requirements are met. 
 
 
•
 
Perform system testing and debugging to ensure that the SAP Finance systems are operating properly. 
 
 
•
 
Develop and maintain SAP Finance system and process documentation. 
 
 
•
 
Maintain an awareness of the latest SAP Finance best practises, trends, and technologies. 
 
 
 
      
Should have experience in taxation (direct, indirect and withhold tax) 
 
 
Requirements: 
 
 
•
 
Qualification in Accounting or a related discipline. 
 
 
•
 
A minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and configuring SAP Finance systems. 
 
 
•
 
Expertise with SAP Finance modules including FI, CO, AP, AR, GL, and AA. 
 
 
•
 
Integration expertise between SAP Finance and other non
-
SAP systems. 
 
 
•
 
Solid analytic and problem
-
solving abilities. 
 
 
•
 
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
